golden_facts.text: Challenge-completion push notifications arrive twice on devices logged into two profiles
Single-profile devices receive exactly one notification
The duplicate reproduces 10 out of 10 times on build 4.0.0-b3
Killing the app or muting one profile does not prevent the duplicate
Earlier 3.x builds with the same dual-profile setup show a single notification

extracted_facts.text: In the 4.0-beta build, push notifications for completed challenges arrive twice on devices where the user is logged into two profiles (personal + coach mode)
The bug is reported with a suggested priority of high
Double push notifications have historically caused uninstalls
The affected app is the Meridian fitness app
Earlier 3.x builds with the same dual-profile setup show a single notification
Both notification copies arrive within a second of each other
Both notification copies deep-link to the same challenge screen
The issue occurs only on dual-profile devices
Single-profile devices receive exactly one notification
The reproduction rate is 10/10 on build 4.0.0-b3
Killing the app does not stop the duplicate notifications
Muting one profile does not stop the duplicate notifications
